'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Brad Reinhold DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Reinhold]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brad Reinhold]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
